title: Do not spend a rare life like loose change
summary: The shabad names the crossing and the waste in the same breath. Effort belongs to the way across; Maya turns the life sideways.
takeaway: Put today’s effort on the crossing, not on the glitter that keeps you circling.
lifeApplication: Notice where Maya is recruiting your energy, then redirect one concrete effort toward Naam, sangat, or seva.

source.shortMeaning: Human life is for crossing the world-ocean, not for being squandered in love of Maya.
source.lifeApplication: When aimlessness starts thinning the day, let one concrete effort move toward the crossing.

evidence.coreClaim: Human life is for crossing the world-ocean, not for being squandered in love of Maya.
evidence.turn: The line turns urgency into direction: make the effort that helps the soul cross.
